text.before: What is an early payment discount?
text.after: What is the formula for calculating an early payment discount?
Take any volume discount off first, then the early pay discount. $24.00 less 6% is $22.56, and 2% off that is $22.11. Freight of $1.40 goes on after both, so the case costs $23.51.
What is an example of marginal cost?
A distributor moving 6,000 cases a month takes on 1,200 more. Those cases add $21,600 of variable cost plus a $6,000 new route, $27,600 in all, so each extra case costs $23.00.
Is reorder point the same as safety stock?
No. Safety stock is the buffer, 229 cases here. The reorder point adds the demand you sell while you wait on the truck, 480 cases over a 4 day lead time, so the trigger sits at 709 cases.
What is another name for par-level inventory?
Par is also called the order-up-to level or the max level. Whatever the name, it is the stock a line should hold right after a delivery lands: 1,080 cases on these defaults.

text.before: What is a landed cost price?
text.after: How do you calculate landed cost?
Add the freight to the case price, then divide by the units in the case. Option C is $19.00 plus $1.20 of freight, $20.20 landed, and 10 units makes it $2.02 a unit.
